00052 SimpleConvolutionUGenInternal::SimpleConvolutionUGenInternal(UGen const& inputA, 
00053                 UGen const& inputB, 
00054                 const int fftSize,
00055                 const int initialDelay) throw()
00056 : UGenInternal(NumInputs),
00057  fftSize_(fftSize),
00058  fftSizeHalved(fftSize / 2),
00059  initialDelay_(initialDelay),
00060  fftEngine(new FFTEngineInternal(fftSize)),
00061  buffers(BufferSpec(fftSize_, NumBuffers, true)),
00062  bufferIndex(initialDelay <= 0 ? 0 : initialDelay >= fftSize_ ? 0 : fftSize_ - initialDelay)
00063 {
00064  inputs[InputA] = inputA;
00065  inputs[InputB] = inputB;
00066 }
00067 
00068 SimpleConvolutionUGenInternal::~SimpleConvolutionUGenInternal()
00069 {
00070  delete fftEngine;
00071 }

00081 void SimpleConvolutionUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00082 {
00083  const int blockSize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00084  int numSamplesToProcess = blockSize;
00085  
00086  float* inputASamples = inputs[InputA].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00087  float* inputBSamples = inputs[InputB].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00088  float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00089  
00090  float* const bufferASamples = buffers.getDataUnchecked(InputA);
00091  float* const bufferBSamples = buffers.getDataUnchecked(InputB);
00092  float* const outputBufferSamples = buffers.getDataUnchecked(Output);
00093   
00094  DSPSplitComplex fftABuffer;
00095  fftABuffer.realp = buffers.getDataUnchecked(ProcessA);
00096  fftABuffer.imagp = fftABuffer.realp + fftSizeHalved;
00097  
00098  DSPSplitComplex fftBBuffer;
00099  fftBBuffer.realp = buffers.getDataUnchecked(ProcessB);
00100  fftBBuffer.imagp = fftBBuffer.realp + fftSizeHalved;
00101  
00102  DSPSplitComplex fftResultBufferSplit;
00103  fftResultBufferSplit.realp = buffers.getDataUnchecked(FFTResult);
00104  fftResultBufferSplit.imagp = fftResultBufferSplit.realp + fftSizeHalved;
00105  
00106  while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00107  {
00108   int bufferSamplesToProcess = fftSize_ - bufferIndex;
00109   
00110   if(bufferSamplesToProcess > numSamplesToProcess)
00111   {   
00112    // buffer the inputs
00113    memcpy(bufferASamples + bufferIndex, inputASamples, numSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));
00114    memcpy(bufferBSamples + bufferIndex, inputBSamples, numSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));
00115    
00116    // ...and the output
00117    memcpy(outputSamples, outputBufferSamples + bufferIndex, numSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));
00118             
00119    bufferIndex += numSamplesToProcess;
00120    inputASamples += numSamplesToProcess;
00121    inputBSamples += numSamplesToProcess;
00122    outputSamples += numSamplesToProcess;
00123    numSamplesToProcess = 0;
00124   }
00125   else
00126   {
00127    numSamplesToProcess -= bufferSamplesToProcess;
00128    
00129    memcpy(bufferASamples + bufferIndex, inputASamples, bufferSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));
00130    memcpy(bufferBSamples + bufferIndex, inputBSamples, bufferSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));
00131    
00132    memcpy(outputSamples, outputBufferSamples + bufferIndex, bufferSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));
00133    
00134    bufferIndex += bufferSamplesToProcess;
00135    inputASamples += bufferSamplesToProcess;
00136    inputBSamples += bufferSamplesToProcess;
00137    outputSamples += bufferSamplesToProcess;
00138    bufferSamplesToProcess = 0;
00139    
00140    // do fft   
00141    fftEngine->fft(fftABuffer, buffers.getDataUnchecked(InputA), true);
00142    fftEngine->fft(fftBBuffer, buffers.getDataUnchecked(InputB), true);
00143    
00144    // convolve
00145    memset(fftResultBufferSplit.realp, 0, fftSize_ * sizeof(float));
00146    MultAndAdd(fftABuffer, fftBBuffer, fftResultBufferSplit, fftSizeHalved / 4);
00147       
00148    // do ifft
00149    fftEngine->ifft(outputBufferSamples, fftResultBufferSplit, true, true);
00150             
00151    bufferIndex = 0;
00152   }
00153  }
00154  
00155 }

00157 SimpleConvolution::SimpleConvolution(UGen const& inputA, 
00158           UGen const& inputB, 
00159           const int fftSize, 
00160           const int initialDelay) throw()
00161 { 
00162  const int fftSizeChecked = Bits::isPowerOf2(fftSize) ? fftSize : Bits::nextPowerOf2(fftSize);
00163 
00164  const int numInputChannels = ugen::max(inputA.getNumChannels(), inputB.getNumChannels());
00165  initInternal(numInputChannels);
00166  
00167  for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00168  {
00169   internalUGens[i] = new SimpleConvolutionUGenInternal(inputA, 
00170                 inputB, 
00171                 fftSizeChecked, 
00172                 initialDelay);
00173  }
00174 }
00175 
00176 OverlapConvolution::OverlapConvolution(UGen const& inputA, UGen const& inputB, const int fftSize, const int overlap) throw()
00177 { 
00178  const int fftSizeChecked = Bits::isPowerOf2(fftSize) ? fftSize : Bits::nextPowerOf2(fftSize);
00179  const int overlapChecked = Bits::isPowerOf2(overlap) ? overlap : Bits::nextPowerOf2(overlap);
00180  
00181  UGenArray overlappingConvolutions;
00182  const int delay = fftSize / overlapChecked;
00183    
00184  for(int i = 0; i < overlap; i++)
00185  {
00186   overlappingConvolutions <<= SimpleConvolution::AR(inputA, inputB, fftSizeChecked, delay * i);
00187  }
00188   
00189  UGen mixer = overlappingConvolutions.mix();
00190  
00191  const int numInputChannels = ugen::max(inputA.getNumChannels(), inputB.getNumChannels());
00192  initInternal(numInputChannels);
00193  
00194  for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00195  {
00196   internalUGens[i] = new BinaryMultiplyUGenInternal(mixer, 1.0 / overlapChecked);
00197  }
00198 }
